mines.mine_notes: Pan Operating Complex acquired Oct 1, 2025 (closed from Calibre Mining); Q4 2025 was company's inaugural quarter as a gold producer. Q4: produced 9,165 oz, sold 8,492 oz (673 oz sold early 2026) — exceeded forecast of 8,500-9,000 oz. Full-year 2025 Pan mine production 35,303 oz met annual guidance (30,000-40,000 oz). Q4 cash costs US$1,549/oz; AISC US$1,604/oz (preliminary; final reconciled figures to be reported). Cash balance US$34M (unrestricted, unaudited) at Dec 31, 2025. Attributable production post-acquisition only: 9,165 oz (Q4); company-level full-year figure reflects Pan mine total 35,303 oz.
Past-producing gold mine, La Paz County, Arizona. Development-stage: permits in hand for restart; pre-feasibility-stage expansion potential.
Gold development project, Zacatecas, Mexico. DFS-stage heap-leach oxide project.

notes: Formerly Minera Alamos Inc.; renamed Mining Americas Inc. ~June 2026 and graduated from TSX-V to TSX. Became a Nevada gold producer with Oct 1, 2025 acquisition of the Pan Operating Complex from Calibre Mining. Added to GDXJ effective Sept 18, 2026. FY2025 Pan mine: full-year production 35,303 oz (guidance 30,000-40,000 oz); company-attributable (post-acquisition Q4) 9,165 oz. Q4 2025 sold 8,492 oz; cash costs US$1,549/oz; AISC US$1,604/oz (preliminary). Cash US$34M at Dec 31, 2025. CEO Darren Koningen. All amounts in USD. Additional listings: OTCQX:MAIFF.
